# macinplay — German Mac preview

- Original source: [macinplay — German Mac preview](https://macinplay.de/spiele-tests/macintosh-games/robin-hood-die-legende-von-sherwood-vorschau/)
- Author / publication: Sven Wernicke / macinplay
- Language / date: German; publication date not verified
- Access: Article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Wernicke compares a Mac demo with the full PC game while discussing the upcoming e.p.i.c. release. The preview praises the accessible controls, sound, narrative, and tactical depth, and describes German voice acting and three difficulty levels.

Its distinctive evidence is performance: the author reports stuttering on a 700 MHz G3 even at 640×480 and questions the port's higher hardware demands. The article describes detailed 2D environments and a maximum resolution of 1024×768.

These are observations from a prerelease demo and that machine. They should not be treated as measurements of later Mac builds. The preview's advertised mission total likewise needs comparison with campaign route conventions.
